name: LG AI Research
one_line: LG Group's AI lab; builds the EXAONE model family and leads the group's AI transformation.

name: NAVER Corporation
one_line: Korea's largest internet company; builds the HyperCLOVA X sovereign LLM and runs the GAK hyperscale data centres.

name: Korea AI Computing Center Co., Ltd.
one_line: Public-private special-purpose company (Samsung SDS-led consortium) that will own and run Korea's National AI Computing Center at Haenam.

name: Coupang, Inc.
one_line: Korea's largest e-commerce and logistics company; runs Coupang Intelligent Cloud.

name: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan
one_line: Taiwan's digital ministry; runs the sovereign-AI programme and the build-own-operate AI computing-centre scheme.

name: Government of Maharashtra
one_line: State government of India's largest industrial state; approved the Maharashtra AI Policy 2026 in April 2026.

name: Soket AI Labs
one_line: Bengaluru AI lab building Project EKA, Indian-language and reasoning models; one of the 12 IndiaAI Mission sovereign-model teams.

name: EuroHPC Joint Undertaking
aliases: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking
one_line: The EU body that buys Europe's public supercomputers and is running the AI Gigafactories tender.

name: Figure AI
one_line: Humanoid-robot company; trains its Helix robot models on large GPU clusters.
